verdict.rationale: Twilio documents port-in itself: a portability check and creating port-in requests for up to 1,000 US numbers. Nothing in the evidence shows port status tracking, an expected completion date, or rejection reasons. The toll-free verification status in the Console is a different feature and does not count toward porting status.

support.subject: As a founder, a port shows its status and expected completion date, and a rejected port says why
